title: A comp that exceeds the manager's limit
question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint about a long wait. Can she?
expected: No on her own: the house policy lets a manager comp up to $25, above that the owner decides. Cites the comps section.

trace.question: My manager wants to comp a $40 meal for a complaint about a long wait. Can she?
trace.answer:
Not on her own authority. Under [house: Comps], a manager can comp up to $25 on a single ticket to resolve a complaint about food quality or a long wait. A long wait is a covered reason, but a $40 comp is over that limit, so she needs your approval. The policy says you can be reached by text during service.

She does have two other options. She could comp up to $25 herself and leave the rest of the ticket as a charge. Or she could text you to approve the full $40.

The same section says total comps in a week should stay under 1% of that week's gross sales. If a week goes over, you review every comp from that week.
